name: Moneytree
official_name_basis: ChatGPTのアプリ詳細画面に表示された名称
provider: マネーツリー株式会社
original_description:
Ask questions about your finances using your Moneytree data.

After connecting your account, you can use ChatGPT to explore your balances and transactions in a simple, conversational way. Understand your spending patterns, track subscriptions, and review recent activity—all based on your actual financial data.

By looking across multiple transactions at once, the app helps you spot trends and habits that are hard to see on your own, making it easier to reflect on your spending and plan ahead.
